breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions in the original prompt (both Dirichlet and Periodic). It resolved this by omitting the incorrect periodic condition, which aligns with the ground truth. The generated specification only mentions the Dirichlet condition: 'Dirichlet boundary conditions are applied on all four edges of the square.'
